info.title: Sales CoPilot API
info.description:
REST API for Sales CoPilot — an AI-powered presentation platform with narrated slides, live Q&A, and deck management.

**Authentication**: Most endpoints require a session cookie obtained from `POST /api/auth/login`. Presentation playback endpoints (`/api/qa`, `/api/narration/*`) also accept a `presentationId` for unauthenticated viewer access.

presentationToken.name: x-presentation-token
presentationToken.description: HMAC-signed token scoped to a specific presentation. Obtained from `POST /api/presentations/{presentationId}/events-token`.

eventType.description: Event type, e.g. presentation.opened, slide.viewed, contract.signed

presentationName.description: Homeowner full name derived from presentation data

deckId.description: Template ID for deep-linking to the template editor

deckContext.description: Background info used to guide AI narration generation

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created the deck. Null for decks created before creator tracking was added.

previewImageUrl.description: Presigned URL for the first slide image

previewImageThumbUrl.description: Presigned URL for the 480px WebP thumbnail rendition of the first slide, sized for deck and template preview cards. Falls back to the full image URL when no thumbnail exists.

generation.description: The latest unsettled generation job (pending, processing, or failed); null once it completed or if the deck was never generated

firstSlideType.description: Slide type of the deck's first slide, or `null` if the deck has no slides. Used by clients to decide whether to render a product tier-card preview instead of the hero image.

firstSlideProductData.description: Product slide configuration for the deck's first slide when `firstSlideType` is `product_pricing_v1`. `null` otherwise.

brandingColors.description: Subset of the deck's branding palette used to render product slide previews. `null` if the deck has no branding configured.

tags.description: Free-form labels stored on the deck metadata. Defaults to an empty array.

audio_url.description: S3 key for the slide audio file

hero_img.description: S3 key for the slide image

hero_img_thumb.description: Presigned URL for the 480px WebP thumbnail rendition of the hero image, sized for editor rails and library grid tiles. Falls back to the full image URL when no thumbnail exists (legacy uploads, SVGs, and images already at or below 480px). Present on deck read endpoints only; omitted from slide create/update responses.

userMessage.description: Background color for homeowner chat message bubbles. Falls back to primary color if not set.

assistantMessage.description: Background color for AI assistant chat message bubbles.

avatar.description: S3 key for rep avatar image

audioUrl.description: S3 key for the pre-generated answer audio

resumePromptText.description: Spoken prompt asking if the viewer wants to continue the presentation

transitionPromptText.description: Spoken bridge from Q&A back into the presentation

createdBy.description: ID of the user who created the presentation. Null for presentations created by an automated integration rather than a user, and for presentations created before creator tracking was added.

leadSource.description: Origin of the lead this presentation was created for, captured once at creation time. The value names the Demand IQ application that recorded the prospect's first touch, such as `hero`, `web-lead`, `stella`, or `webhook`. `unknown` means the prospect exists but has no recorded first touch. Null for presentations created before lead source tracking was added, and for presentations where the origin could not be determined.

PresentationSlide.description: A slide as served to the presentation viewer. Media URLs are presigned and expire, so responses containing this schema must not be cached.

audioUrl.description: Presigned URL for the slide's narration audio. Expires after a short window.

heroImg.description: Presigned URL for the slide image. Expires after a short window.

PresentationQaSettings.description: Q&A prompt configuration as served to the presentation viewer, with presigned audio URLs.

resumePromptText.description: Spoken prompt asking if the viewer wants to continue the presentation

resumePromptAudioUrl.description: Presigned URL for the resume prompt audio

transitionPromptText.description: Spoken bridge from Q&A back into the presentation

transitionPromptAudioUrl.description: Presigned URL for the transition prompt audio

audioUrl.description: Accessible URL for the synthesized audio
Accessible URL for the TTS audio of the answer

GenerationStatus.description: A deck generation job. The single-job endpoint (`GET /api/decks/{deckId}/generate/status`) adds the row counts and timestamps; the deck list and the per-organization poll carry only the fields common to both.

currentSlide.description: The slide that most recently STARTED processing; completed work is currentSlide − 1

totalSlides.description: 0 until the job flips to processing

progress.description: 0-100, derived from completed slides / totalSlides; 100 once settled

slidesCreated.description: Slide rows that exist for the deck right now. This is the signal to refresh on: currentSlide marks a slide's start, and the row lands a full slide's work later. Single-job endpoint only.

faqsCreated.description: FAQ rows that exist right now. The job tracks no FAQ state; they are written in one batch after the last slide. Single-job endpoint only.

isLibraryAuthor.description: Whether this organization can publish shared library templates.

welcomeSeenAt.description: Timestamp when the org first exited the welcome wizard (saved or skipped the confirm-info step). `null` for organizations that have never completed the wizard.

backgroundImage.description: S3 key or URL for intro background image

channelConfig.description: Channel-specific configuration (e.g. URL for webhook, toEmails for email)

payload.description: Event payload. Carries identifiers (e.g. `presentationId`, `deliveryId`), never contact details such as email addresses. On entries with `archivedAt` set, the payload is reduced to identifier and classification fields; question and answer text is removed.

recipientEmail.description: Present on `email.sent` entries only. The recipient of that delivery, resolved from the delivery attempt referenced by the payload's `deliveryId`. `null` when the delivery attempt has no recipient on record.

archivedAt.description: Set when the entry has aged past the 90-day retention window. The entry stays in the log, but its payload keeps identifier and classification fields only. For `question.asked` and `question.escalated`, the question and answer text is removed. `null` for entries still inside the window.

ProductSlideData.description: Good/better/best product pricing tiers for a product pricing slide.

brandLogo.description: Deprecated. The product pricing slide always renders the deck's branding logo (set via `PUT /api/decks/{deckId}/branding`). This field is still accepted and stored, but the viewer and editor ignore it.

TourState.description: Per-user state for the presentations onboarding modal (ENG-641; versioned in ENG-636). The modal shows at most once per user across devices per content version. The show/hide decision keys on `tourVersion`: whenever it is less than the current content version, the modal is shown. `tourCompletedAt` means the user clicked the "Get Started" button on the single-screen video modal; `tourDismissedAt` covers every other close (X, Esc, navigation, or a silent legacy backfill from the old per-browser `localStorage` flag). Both timestamps are written once and never cleared, so they preserve the first-ever moment even after later content versions are acknowledged.

tourCompletedAt.description: Timestamp of the first-ever completion. `null` until the user clicks "Get Started" for the first time. Never overwritten by a later version acknowledgement.

tourDismissedAt.description: Timestamp of the first-ever dismissal. `null` until dismissed. Never overwritten by a later version acknowledgement.

tourVersion.description: Highest onboarding content version the user has acknowledged. `0` = never onboarded, `1` = illustrated multi-step tour (ENG-641), `2` = Wistia explainer video (ENG-636). The modal shows whenever this is below the current content version. Bumping the current version re-shows the modal to every user exactly once.

get.description: Returns the 10 most recent presentation events for your organization, enriched with the homeowner name, address, and template ID for deep-linking.
Returns all decks for the authenticated organization, ordered by most recently created.

deckContext.description: Background information to guide AI narration generation (e.g. audience, purpose)

get.summary: Poll generation status for every deck
get.description: The latest unsettled generation job for every deck in the organization, keyed by deck id. Completed jobs are omitted, so a deck absent from the map has nothing running. Cheap enough to poll while a template is being built — unlike `GET /api/decks`, it carries no preview URLs.

200.description: Unsettled jobs keyed by deck id

post.summary: Import a presentation as a deck
post.description:
Imports a slide presentation and creates a fully persisted image-based deck from it. Each slide is rendered to a PNG image, and speaker notes become the editable narration script for that slide (the original notes are retained separately). The original source file and rendered slide images are stored alongside the deck and removed when the deck is deleted.

The `source` query parameter selects the import format. `pptx` (PowerPoint) is currently the only supported source. PowerPoint files are limited to 25 MB and 50 slides, and the request body as a whole is limited to 30 MB.

Imports are atomic: if any step fails, no deck or slides are created and any stored files are cleaned up. Non-fatal issues (for example, a slide that rendered with reduced fidelity) are reported in the `import.warnings` array of the response.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Slide import source format. Only `pptx` is currently supported.

file.description: The presentation file. For `source=pptx`, exactly one `.pptx` file up to 25 MB with at most 50 slides.

201.description: Deck created from the imported presentation

status.description: Always `succeeded` in a 201 response. Failed imports return an error status code instead.

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues encountered during the import.

slideIndex.description: Zero-based index of the affected slide, when the warning applies to a single slide.

400.description: Bad request. The `code` field identifies the problem: `source_required` (missing `source` query parameter), `unsupported_source` (the response also includes a `supportedSources` array), `invalid_form_data`, `invalid_metadata`, or `invalid_pptx` (wrong extension, media type, or unreadable file).

413.description: Request too large. The request body exceeds 30 MB (`request_too_large`) or the PowerPoint file exceeds 25 MB.

422.description: The presentation could not be converted into a deck: it contains no slides (`empty_import`) or a slide failed to render (`invalid_rendered_slide`).

500.description: Internal server error (`deck_import_failed`). No deck is created and uploaded files are cleaned up.

get.description: Returns the full deck including slides, FAQs, branding, and Q&A settings.

generation.description: The latest unsettled generation job; null once it completed or if the deck was never generated

tags.description: Replaces the deck's tag list. Pass an empty array or `null` to clear all tags. Falsy entries are filtered out.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a deck and all associated slides, FAQs, and branding. For decks created via `POST /api/decks/import`, the stored source file and rendered slide images are removed as well.

slideIds.description: Full ordered array of slide UUIDs. Position in array becomes the new orderIndex.

post.description: Creates a FAQ and automatically generates TTS audio for the answer.

warning.description: Present if audio generation failed (FAQ is still saved)

200.description: Branding configuration, or null if not yet set

put.description: Creates or replaces the branding configuration for a deck.

avatar.description: S3 key for rep avatar image

get.description: Returns the customizable resume and transition prompts for the deck's Q&A experience.

post.description: Accepts uploaded slide images, runs them through GPT-4o Vision to extract content, generates narration scripts, and synthesizes audio. Returns a job ID — poll `/api/decks/{deckId}/generate/status` for progress.

images.description: Slide images (PNG, JPG, or WebP; max 10 MB each)

get.description: Returns all non-deleted presentations created from this deck.

post.description:
Creates a personalized presentation. Provide `homeowner`, `prospect_id`, or both — at least one is required. With only `homeowner`, a new prospect is created from it. With only `prospect_id`, homeowner data is fetched from that prospect's journey. With both, the supplied homeowner data is used as-is and the existing prospect is attached (it must be visible to your credential — otherwise 422 `PROSPECT_NOT_FOUND`). The address is validated via Google Geocoding. Returns a shareable URL immediately; audio generation may continue in the background.

Price inputs are optional. If a product pricing slide uses formula variables that are not supplied, the price is deferred — the slide displays a placeholder instead of failing. Deferred prices can be resolved later when the missing values become available (e.g., after roof measurements). Sales CoPilot defers a measurement-backed variable only when a formula on one of the deck's product-pricing slides references it. Price variables left in the deck's settings after their product slide was removed, or after its formula stopped referencing them, are ignored. While the deck itself is still being generated, the request is refused with 409 `DECK_GENERATING`: a presentation is a permanent snapshot of the deck at creation time, so one taken mid-generation would be permanently missing slides. Retry once the generation job completes.

prospect_id.description: Prospect to attach the presentation to. Alone, homeowner data is fetched from the prospect's journey; with `homeowner`, the prospect is attached and the supplied data is used as-is. Must be visible to your credential.

price_inputs.description: Values for deck-level price variables (used to evaluate formulas). Optional — omitted variables result in deferred pricing rather than an error.

measurement_strategy.description: Set to `auto` to resolve measurement-backed price variables from automated roof measurements instead of supplying them in `price_inputs`. Only variables referenced by a formula on the deck's product-pricing slides are deferred to measurements.

400.description: Bad request — malformed input, or the deck has no slides (`"Deck has no slides"`). A presentation cannot be created from an empty deck.

409.description: Conflict: `DECK_GENERATING` — the deck is still being generated. This check runs before the empty-deck check, so a job that has not written its first slide yet returns 409, not 400. Transient; retry once the job settles.

422.description: Unprocessable: `INVALID_ADDRESS` (address could not be verified), `PROSPECT_NOT_FOUND` (prospect_id does not exist or belongs to another organization — permanent, do not retry), or `PROSPECT_CREATE_FAILED` (prospect data was rejected upstream)

503.description: Upstream service is unreachable — retry with backoff

patch.description: Partial update for homeowner data, voice settings, language, or price inputs.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a presentation (sets `deletedAt`). The shareable URL stops working immediately.

get.description: Returns the current processing status and slide readiness.

post.description:
Answers a viewer question. Checks FAQs first (exact then semantic match at >= 0.6 confidence), falls back to GPT-4o with slide context. Returns answer text plus synthesized audio.

`deckId` and `presentationId` must be valid UUIDs; other values are rejected with a 400. If `slideId` doesn't match a slide in the deck, the question is answered without slide context instead of failing.

**Authentication**: Accepts either a session cookie (admin) or a `presentationId` (public viewer).

slideId.description: Current slide ID for context. Accepts a slide UUID or a legacy semantic ID such as `slide-1`.

post.description: Generates TTS audio for a slide script. Results are cached per session.
Batch TTS generation. Per-slide failures return a fallback audio URL rather than failing the whole batch.
Generates the spoken bridge from Q&A back into the presentation, using the deck's configured transition prompt.

get.description: Returns all uploaded images for the authenticated organization.

post.description: Uploads and optimizes an image (Sharp: max 1920px width; JPEG quality 85, or WebP quality 80 when `format=webp`). Returns the S3 key and a presigned URL.

file.description: Image file (PNG, JPG, WebP, or SVG; max 10 MB)

format.description: Opt into WebP output, for slide imagery. Omit for anything that may be embedded in an email — Outlook desktop cannot render WebP. Default output is JPEG, or PNG when the source has transparency.

delete.description: Permanently removes the image, its thumbnail rendition and its database row. Refused with 409 while any deck or presentation still references the key; clear the reference first.

409.description: Image is still in use; nothing was deleted

get.description: Returns a curated list of voices suitable for sales presentations.
Returns `{ ok: true }` if the service is running.

post.description: Authenticates with email and password. Returns user and organization info and sets a session cookie. Rate-limited to prevent brute-force attacks.

200.description: Login successful. A `session` cookie is set on the response.

400.description: Missing email or password, a request body that is not valid JSON, or a body that is valid JSON but not an object. The `error` field distinguishes the cases: `Request body must be valid JSON`, `Request body must be a JSON object`, or a message naming the missing field.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded. Only failed credential attempts count toward the limit; requests rejected with a 400 for a malformed body do not.

post.description: Revokes the current session and clears the session cookie.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's identity and organization.

onboarding.description: Per-user onboarding tour state. Omitted when the lookup fails — clients should treat a missing field as "do not show the tour" (fail-closed).

get.summary: Portal SSO via auth code exchange
get.description:
Exchanges a short-lived authorization code for an access token via the Core API, creates a new session, and redirects to the requested path. Used by the portal to embed Sales CoPilot in an iframe.

Flow:
1. Exchange `code` via Core API `POST /auth/code/exchange` (Basic auth with SSO client credentials)
2. Validate the returned access token via `/user/me` to get user/org info
3. Create a new session (always — never reuses an existing one)
4. Set session cookie (plus embedded cookie if `embedded=1`)
5. Revoke any prior session (best-effort)
6. Redirect to a clean URL (no `code` param in the final location)

Redirect URLs use the `APP_URL` environment variable as the canonical base origin when set. This is required for production deployments behind a load balancer where the internal hostname differs from the public URL.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Short-lived authorization code issued by the portal

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: Internal path to redirect to after successful authentication

parameters.name: embedded
parameters.description: Set to `1` when running inside a portal iframe. Enables embedded mode cookies and error handling.

parameters.name: theme
parameters.description: Portal theme preference. When set, a theme cookie is stored so the initial render matches the portal appearance without a flash.

302.description: Redirects to the `redirect` path on success, or to `/login?error=sso_failed` (standalone) / `/embedded-auth-error` (embedded) on failure. Returns a redirect on missing or invalid code, or Core API rejection.

post.description:
Token-bearer variant of the SSO flow for cross-origin clients (for example, the portal calling Sales CoPilot APIs from the browser).

Differs from `GET /api/auth/sso` in four ways:
- Accepts the SSO code in a JSON body, not a query parameter
- Returns the session token in the response body instead of setting a cookie
- Emits CORS headers so the portal origin can read the response
- Does not set the embedded or theme cookies (those are iframe-only concerns)

The returned `token` is the same opaque session ID that backs the cookie flow. Clients send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on subsequent requests.

When `spoof` is present, the session is minted for the target company via Core's `loginAs`. Core authorizes the impersonation; a rejection returns `403 spoof_forbidden`. A `spoof` value equal to the authenticating user's own company is treated as a no-op, not an error. The `organization` field in the response reflects the effective (spoof target) tenant. Unlike the GET SSO flow, this endpoint does not revoke prior sessions for the user — there is no signal to identify the caller's prior bearer session, and revoking all sessions would kill any active iframe session in another tab.

On success, default email notification subscriptions are provisioned for the authenticating user's own organization before any spoof is applied.

code.description: Short-lived authorization code issued by the portal

spoof.description: Optional company UUID to impersonate. Must be a valid UUID; Core authorizes the impersonation.

200.description: Session minted. The `token` is the bearer session ID; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on subsequent requests.

expiresAt.description: Session deadline at mint time. Rolling: it moves forward on every successful renewal (`POST /api/auth/session/renew`), so a live client's real expiry drifts past this value. Never a hard cap.

idleTimeoutSeconds.description: Sliding idle window measured against the session's last activity. Default `25200` (7h). Independent of `absoluteMaxAgeSeconds` — either can force re-auth first.

absoluteMaxAgeSeconds.description: Rolling session lifetime in seconds (`SESSION_LIFETIME`, default `86400`). Re-set at creation and on every renewal, so this is the size of the rolling window, not an absolute cap. The wire key stays `absoluteMaxAgeSeconds` for portal compatibility.

organization.description: Effective tenant — the spoof target when spoofing, otherwise the user's own company.

400.description: Missing or invalid `code`, non-UUID `spoof` value, or non-JSON body. Error codes: `invalid_body`, `invalid_request`.

401.description: SSO code expired or invalid. Error code: `invalid_code`.

403.description: Request origin not allowed, authenticating user has no associated company (`invalid_user`), or Core rejected the spoof request (`spoof_forbidden`).

503.description: Core authentication service unavailable. Error code: `core_api_unavailable`.

options.summary: CORS preflight for the SSO exchange
options.description: Returns `204 No Content` with CORS headers when the `Origin` is allowed, or `403 Forbidden` when it is not.

get.description: Returns the organization's contact details used in contracts and branding.

post.summary: Mark the welcome wizard as seen
post.description: Records that this organization deliberately exited the first-time welcome wizard by saving or explicitly skipping the confirm-info step. Idempotent — the timestamp is written only on the first successful call (subsequent calls preserve the original value via `COALESCE`). Merely viewing the welcome screen does not count; the client should call this only after a user action that ends the wizard.

get.description: Returns the company's knowledge base profile that guides how the AI answers customer questions.

put.description: Updates the company tagline, about text, trust signals, service coverage, and answer style used by the AI.

get.description: Returns all uploaded knowledge base documents for the organization, with usage metadata.

post.description: Validates the file and returns a presigned S3 URL for direct upload. Call `/api/company/kb/documents/complete` after the upload finishes.

uploadUrl.description: Presigned S3 URL for PUT upload

400.description: Bad request (invalid file type, size, or document limit reached)

post.description: Marks a document as uploaded after the client finishes uploading to S3. Triggers background processing (text extraction, chunking, and embedding).

delete.description: Removes the document from S3 and the database. Associated chunks are deleted automatically.

post.description: Uploads a contract document (PDF or Word) and uses AI to analyze the full document for template conversion. Legacy Word files (.doc) are converted to .docx automatically before analysis. Returns a markdown template with variable placeholders, the list of detected variables, and a one-sentence summary of the contract.

file.description: Contract file (PDF or Word .docx/.doc, max 10 MB)

markdownTemplate.description: The complete contract converted to Markdown, with detected values replaced by {{variable}} placeholders.
markdownTemplate.example:
# Solar Installation Agreement

This agreement is between {{full_name}} of {{address}} and {{company_name}}...

detectedVariables.description: Variables detected in the document and replaced in the template.

originalText.description: The exact text that was replaced.

suggestedVariable.description: The variable name used in the template.

context.description: Where this value appears in the contract.
context.example: Customer name in the agreement header

summary.description: One sentence describing the contract type.

400.description: Bad request (unsupported file type, file too large, or the document could not be processed)

500.description: Internal server error (including when .doc conversion is unavailable in the current environment)

get.description: Returns all action configurations (contract templates) for a deck.

post.description: Creates a new contract template or action configuration for a deck.

get.description: Returns the intro page configuration for a deck, including the background image, headline, and CTA button label.

200.description: Intro configuration, or null if not set

put.description: Creates or updates the intro page for a deck. Enabling an intro page switches the deck to lazy generation mode.

backgroundImage.description: S3 key for the intro background image

get.description: Returns the good/better/best product pricing tiers for a product pricing slide.

put.description: Sets product pricing tiers for a slide. The slide type is automatically set to `product_pricing_v1`.

delete.description: Removes product data and resets the slide type to `standard`.

get.description: Returns all notification subscriptions for the organization.

post.description: Subscribes to an event type via a delivery channel (webhook, email, or console).

channelConfig.description: Channel-specific config. Webhook: `{ url }`. Email: `{ toEmails: ["a@b.com"] }`.

get.description: Returns a paginated, filterable log of all events for the organization. `email.sent` entries include a top-level `recipientEmail` field resolved from the delivery attempt; event payloads themselves carry identifiers only, never email addresses. Entries older than 90 days stay in the log with `archivedAt` set and their payloads reduced to identifier and classification fields; question and answer text is removed at that point.

post.description: Triggers lazy generation when a viewer clicks the CTA on the intro page. Safe to call multiple times — duplicate generation requests are ignored.

get.summary: Get presentation slides and Q&A settings
get.description: Returns the slide payload and Q&A settings for a presentation. The presentation viewer fetches this behind the intro or loading screen so the initial page load stays small. Requires an `x-presentation-token` scoped to this presentation. Expired tokens are rejected with `401` — reload the presentation page to obtain a fresh one. Audio and image URLs in the response are freshly signed on every call and expire, so the response is marked `Cache-Control: private, no-store` and must not be cached.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired presentation token

get.description: Returns all product tier selections the viewer has made during the presentation.

200.description: Product selections keyed by slide ID

put.description: Saves a product tier selection for a specific slide during the presentation.

400.description: Bad request (validation error, or a request body that is not valid JSON or not a JSON object)

get.description: Returns the contract template, company branding, and product data needed to render the signing view. Requires an `x-presentation-token` scoped to this presentation, matching the sibling `events` and `appointment` routes. Obtain the token from `POST /api/presentations/{presentationId}/events-token`.

parameters.name: configId
parameters.description: Action config to use (uses published config if omitted)

post.description: Submits a contract signature. Validates the typed signature against the customer name, resolves the template with variables, and creates an audit-trailed signed document. Requires an `x-presentation-token` scoped to this presentation, matching the sibling `events` and `appointment` routes. Obtain the token from `POST /api/presentations/{presentationId}/events-token`. Soft-deleted presentations are refused with `404` even when the caller holds a still-valid token minted before the delete. Client-supplied `variables` are filtered through an allow-list before storage. Non-whitelisted keys are dropped rather than persisted to `resolvedVariables`.

variables.description: Variable values substituted into the template. Keys outside the server-side allow-list are dropped before storage. The allow-list covers customer fields (`first_name`, `last_name`, `full_name`, `address`, `city`, `state`, `zip`, `email`, `phone`), company fields (`company_name`, `company_address`, `company_city`, `company_state`, `company_zip`, `company_phone`, `company_email`, `license_number`, `rep_name`), and date fields (`today`, `month`, `year`, `date`, `signature_timestamp`). Non-string values are also dropped.

signature.description: Typed signature (must match the customer name)

400.description: Bad request (signature mismatch, validation error, or a request body that is not valid JSON or not a JSON object)

404.description: Presentation not found, presentation soft-deleted, deck missing, or contract template not found.

post.description: Ingests interaction events from the presentation viewer (opens, slide views, CTA clicks). Authenticated via an HMAC token in the request body. Every slide exit is recorded: `slide_viewed` accepts an optional `skipped` flag for views under the 2-second skip threshold, and `slide_viewed_batch` submits up to 25 slide views in one request. Each view in a batch counts against the rate limit individually, so batching reduces requests without raising the effective write cap. The `action_detection` and `action_execution` types, and untyped Q&A interaction bodies, are acknowledged with `200` for backward compatibility but are no longer stored.

type.description: Event type. `action_detection` and `action_execution` are deprecated: they are acknowledged but not stored.

skipped.description: Whether the viewer left the slide in under 2 seconds. A flag, not a filter: fast flips are still recorded as `slide_viewed` events.

views.description: Slide views to record in one request. Required when `type` is `slide_viewed_batch`. Each view counts against the rate limit individually.

ctaUrl.description: Destination URL of an `external_link` CTA. Send it only on `cta_clicked` events for that CTA type.

post.description: Validates a physical address using geocoding. Returns formatted address, coordinates, and normalized components.

get.description: Returns a list of available Google Fonts for use in deck branding. Results are cached for 24 hours.

post.description: Generates TTS audio for a single slide script. Requires an authenticated session. Use `/api/narration/single` for session-based caching or `/api/narration/batch` for multiple slides.
Generates TTS audio for Q&A transition or resume prompts. Uses the deck's configured voice and prompt settings.
Returns the configured resume prompt text for a deck, along with pre-generated audio if available. Falls back to a default prompt when no deck-specific settings exist.

post.summary: Analyze a slide image and generate content
post.description: Uses AI vision to analyze a slide image and generate a narration script with key points. Optionally uses deck context and slide-specific context to improve the output.

imageUrl.description: URL of the slide image to analyze

slideId.description: Slide ID (used for intro slide detection)

post.description: Generates preview audio for all slides in a deck that have narration scripts but no audio yet. Useful for previewing a deck before sending presentations.

generatedCount.description: Number of slides for which preview audio was generated

get.description: Returns the current preview audio generation status for a deck, including how many slides need preview generation.

post.description: Exchanges an existing presentation token (which may be expired up to 7 days) for a fresh HMAC token. Used by the presentation viewer to maintain event tracking authentication. Rate-limited to 10 requests per minute per presentation.

_token.description: Existing presentation token (may be expired up to 7 days)

expiresAt.description: Unix timestamp when the token expires

get.description: Returns available appointment time slots grouped by date, along with any existing appointment for the presentation. Authenticated via a presentation token. Rate-limited to 30 requests per minute.

post.description: Books an appointment for a presentation viewer. Validates the time slot is still available and creates the appointment. Rate-limited to 10 requests per minute.

409.description: Conflict (slot already booked or appointment already exists)

post.description: Initiates an automated roof measurement request for a homeowner address. The address is validated before submission. Poll `/api/roof-measurements/{requestId}/status` for results.

get.description:
Returns the current status and results of a roof measurement request. Poll this endpoint until the status reaches a terminal state (`completed`, `failed`, `timed_out`, `cancelled`, or `skipped`).

A request moves through `pending` → `creating_prospect` → `requesting_ev` → `polling_ev` → `completed`. If the EagleView request fails (for example, when the address is unserviceable or the upstream API rejects it), the status transitions to `fetching_fallback` and the system attempts a calculated roof measurement before failing. When fallback succeeds, the result's `source` is `calc` instead of `ev`; the `error` field retains the original EagleView error message for debugging.

post.description: Cancels or skips an in-progress roof measurement request. Use `cancel` to abort entirely or `skip` to mark it as skipped and proceed without measurements.

Uses AI (with regex fallback) to classify a viewer's natural-language response during a Q&A pause. Returns whether the viewer wants to continue the presentation, go back to the previous slide, or ask another question.

When the viewer was navigated to a different slide to answer a question, the classification includes a `go_back` option so they can return to where they were.

userResponse.description: The viewer's spoken or typed response

promptText.description: The prompt that was shown to the viewer (e.g. "Would you like to continue?")

didNavigateToNewSlide.description: Whether the viewer was navigated to a different slide to answer their question

currentSlideTitle.description: Title of the slide currently displayed (used for context when classifying)

intent.description: `continue` — resume the presentation from the current slide. `go_back` — return to the slide before the Q&A detour (only when `didNavigateToNewSlide` is true). `question` — the viewer has a new question.

post.summary: Detect a voice or text command
post.description: Parses natural-language input (from voice or text) to detect presentation control commands such as navigation, audio control, and CTA actions. Rate-limited to 10 requests per minute per IP and presentation.

action.description: Specific action (e.g. next, pause, open_cta, resume_here)

post.summary: Record a presentations onboarding completion or dismissal
post.description: Records that the current user completed or dismissed the presentations onboarding modal (ENG-641; versioned in ENG-636). The server records the acknowledged content version (`CURRENT_ONBOARDING_VERSION`, currently `2`) on the user's row and returns the full updated `TourState` so callers can write it straight into the shared `/api/auth/me` cache. Idempotent per `(organization, user, version)`: the underlying upsert only fires when the stored `tourVersion` is behind the incoming version, so a repeat call at the same version is a no-op and never overwrites `tourCompletedAt` or `tourDismissedAt`. A PostHog `onboarding_milestone` event (`tour_completed` or `tour_dismissed`, keyed on organization ID, carrying a `tour_version` property) is captured only on the first transition to a new version; subsequent calls emit no analytics. Pass `legacy: true` (only valid with `action: "dismissed"`) to silently backfill users carrying the old per-browser `templates_onboarding_seen_v1` localStorage flag: the row is written at `LEGACY_TOUR_VERSION` (`1`) so the user stays eligible for newer content, and no event fires.

action.description: `completed` — user clicked the "Get Started" button on the onboarding modal. `dismissed` — any other close (X, Esc, or navigation). Overlay clicks do not dismiss the modal.

source.description: Which page the tour was shown on. Used for analytics attribution only; it does not affect persistence.

legacy.description: Set to `true` to backfill a user with the deprecated per-browser localStorage flag. Silent — no PostHog event is emitted. Only valid when `action` is `dismissed`.

200.description: Updated tour state for the current user

400.description: Invalid JSON body, unknown `action`/`source`, or `legacy: true` combined with `action: "completed"`
